name: Together AI

description: Commercial Together AI platform (together.ai). Pricing page verified 2026-11-09 lists per-1M-token serverless rates across many open models (examples on page include free/zero-priced experimental rows and paid models such as DeepSeek/Qwen/Kimi families) — treat the live pricing table as authoritative.
